about: Pit Wall parts catalogue. Shared by the server (rolls parts, sums the car spec) and the Godot client (garage cards, car sprites). A part's stats are integers; the car spec is the sum over the six fitted parts plus traits and synergies. Every part spends the same lap-time budget, so parts are different, not better.

downforce.label: Downforce
downforce.description: Change to downforce, in tenths of a percent (k_down x (1000 + v) / 1000).

drag.label: Drag
drag.description: Change to drag, in tenths of a percent; negative is faster on straights (k_drag x (1000 + v) / 1000).

balance.label: Aero balance
balance.description: Points of aero balance moved to the front axle, in thousandths of the downforce share (front_share + v / 1000). Positive: sharper turn-in, lighter rear.

power.label: Power
power.description: Kilowatts added to the 400 kW combustion engine.

harvest.label: Energy recovery
harvest.description: Change to energy harvested under braking and lift-off, in tenths of a percent.

grip.label: Mechanical grip
grip.description: Change to tyre peak grip, in tenths of a percent.

traction.label: Traction
traction.description: Change to drive force and rear grip under power out of slow corners, in tenths of a percent.

lapWeights.unit: lap-time points per stat unit: 1 point = 0.001% of lap time, positive = faster
lapWeights.source: Quasi-steady-state lap model of car_sim.gd constants on Mtkvari (ideal driver, steady-state energy). Recalibrate when the physics changes.

street.name: Street
street.about: Slow corners, short straights, heavy braking.

budget.about: Every rolled part's lap-time points (stats x weights, traits included) equal points x (1 + rarity bonus) minus the traits' budget cost, within the tolerance. 50 points = 0.05% of lap time, so six earned parts are worth about 0.3% over the starter car on the calibration circuit. Track fit, synergy and setup decide the rest.

high_downforce.name: High downforce
high_downforce.about: Load first: strong in corners, draggy.

ground_effect.name: Ground effect
ground_effect.about: The floor makes the load; the rest of the car feeds it.

baseline.name: Standard front wing
baseline.description: The team's standard wing: no strengths, no weaknesses.

outwash.name: Outwash front wing
outwash.description: Flap tips and endplates turn the air outward, pushing the front tyres' wake away from the floor: strong, steady front load for some drag.

inwash.name: Inwash front wing
inwash.description: Turns the flow inboard, toward the centre of the car and under the floor, as the 2022 rules intended: less front load and drag, a calmer wake.

highnose.name: High-nose front wing
highnose.description: A raised nose and a wing hung on pylons leave a wide channel for air to reach the floor, feeding the ground-effect tunnels.

baseline.name: Standard rear wing
baseline.description: The team's standard rear wing: a middle-of-the-road compromise.

spoon.name: Spoon rear wing
spoon.description: A spoon-shaped mainplane, deep in the middle and shallow at the tips: sheds drag for long straights and gives up rear load.

highdf.name: High-downforce rear wing
highdf.description: A deep mainplane and steep flap for maximum rear load: planted in fast corners, slow on the straights and hungry for battery.

beam.name: Beam-wing rear wing
beam.description: A large beam wing below the main wing pulls air out of the diffuser, so the floor makes more of the rear load at moderate drag.

downwash.name: Downwash sidepods
downwash.description: Sidepods that slope steeply down to the rear, sending air onto the top of the floor and toward the beam wing.

zeropod.name: Zero-pod sidepods
zeropod.description: Minimal sidepods with tiny inlets: the least frontal area and drag, but tight cooling holds the power unit back.

undercut.name: Undercut sidepods
undercut.description: A deep undercut below the inlets channels air along the floor edge to seal the tunnels: more floor load, a warmer power unit.

high_rake.name: High-rake floor
high_rake.description: Runs nose-down with the rear high, growing the diffuser's volume: big load and a forward balance, but a stiff, twitchy platform.

low_rake.name: Low-rake floor
low_rake.description: A flat, low platform: efficient and calm over bumps, with less peak load.

venturi.name: Venturi floor
venturi.description: Deep venturi tunnels under the car make ground-effect downforce with little drag; it needs a stiff, low car, so mechanical grip suffers.

baseline.name: Standard suspension
baseline.description: Standard double wishbones, set up to be safe.

pushrod.name: Push-rod suspension
pushrod.description: The rod runs from the bottom of the upright up to a rocker high on the chassis: compliant and easy to tune, with good mechanical grip and traction.

pullrod.name: Pull-rod suspension
pullrod.description: The rod runs from the top of the upright down to a rocker low in the chassis: lower centre of gravity and cleaner flow to the floor, but stiffer.

baseline.name: Standard power unit
baseline.description: The customer power unit on its standard map.

torque.name: Torque-map power unit
torque.description: Engine and hybrid mapped for low and mid-range torque: punches out of slow corners.

topend.name: Top-end power unit
topend.description: Mapped for peak power at high revs: fastest on long straights, but it harvests less energy.

efficiency.name: Efficiency power unit
efficiency.description: Maximum energy recovery and careful deployment: more Boost per lap, less peak power.

street_specialist.name: Street specialist
street_specialist.description: Tuned for slow corners: more traction and low-speed grip, a little more drag.

low_drag.name: Low drag
low_drag.description: Trimmed for the straights: less drag, less load.

floor_synergy.name: Floor synergy
floor_synergy.description: Shaped to feed one floor philosophy: +4 downforce when the fitted floor is from the same family. Costs some of the part's budget.

cool_running.name: Cool running
cool_running.description: Runs cool, so the cooling openings can close up: less drag, a slightly lower power ceiling.

kerb_friendly.name: Kerb friendly
kerb_friendly.description: Compliant over kerbs and bumps: keeps mechanical grip, loses a little aero platform.

efficient.name: Efficient
efficient.description: Recovers more energy under braking, at a small cost in peak power.

front_bite.name: Front bite
front_bite.description: Extra front load for a sharper turn-in; the rear goes lighter.

planted_rear.name: Planted rear
planted_rear.description: Stable on corner exits, a touch lazier on turn-in.

synergies.name: Matched aero family
synergies.description: Front wing, rear wing and floor share one philosophy, so the airflow works as one system.

synergies.name: Clean floor edge
synergies.description: Sidepods and floor from the same family keep the floor edge sealed.

synergies.name: Wake mismatch
synergies.description: The outwash wing loads the nose while the spoon wing sheds rear load: the car oversteers in fast corners.

synergies.name: Stiff platform
synergies.description: Pull-rod suspension holds the venturi floor at a steady ride height.

synergies.name: Pitch sensitive
synergies.description: Soft push-rod suspension lets the venturi floor pitch and stall under braking.

first_quali.name: First qualifying lap of the day
